title: David Sinclair plans to test whole-body rejuvenation drugs in the XPrize competition
brief: David Sinclair, a prominent longevity researcher, plans to initiate human trials of an oral "reprogramming" drug designed to reverse aging as part of a $101 million XPrize competition. This represents a shift from theory to clinical testing of whole-body rejuvenation therapeutics, potentially advancing the field's goal of developing age-reversal treatments.
